# ADR 0003: Partition by account to keep order while running in parallel

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Mobile money fraud rules engine

## Context

Velocity and mule rules depend on event order per account.

## Decision

Hash origin account to one of N single-threaded workers fed by bounded queues.

## Consequences

Deterministic results equal to sequential replay; back-pressure built in.

## Alternatives considered

Unordered parallel streams (wrong results).
